Profile Dibrompropamidine isetionate is an aromatic diamidine antisep- tic similar to propamidine (p.1660). It is bactericidal against Gram-positive bacteria but is less active against Gram-negative bacteria and spore-forming organisms. It also has antifungal properties. It is available as topical preparations for the local treatment of minor eye and skin infections. Dichlordimethylhydantoin Diclorodimetilhidantoína. 1,3-Dichloro-5,5-dimethylhydantoin; 1,3-Dichloro-5,5-dimethylimidazolidine-2,4-dione. C5H6Cl2N2O2 = 197.0. CAS — 118-52-5. Profile Dichlordimethylhydantoin is a disinfectant used as a source of chlorine, for sterilising food and dairy equipment and as a bleach. It contains about 72% w/w of ‘available chlorine’ (see p.1638). Bromochlorodimethylhydantoin (C5H6N2O2BrCl = 241.5) is a closely related bromine-releasing compound used for the disin- fection of swimming-pool water.
